Subject: Renewal: pricing follow-up & volume step-ups for Acme Health

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps on pricing/volume so procurement has what they need to review:

Summary of current + planned usage
- Current baseline: ~25M tokens / month (prod + staging)
- Near-term step-up (Q3): targeting 50M tokens / month
- Growth target (12 months): 200M+ tokens / month as new routes and models are added

Budget & unit economics we discussed
- Budget range you shared on the call: roughly $10k–$25k / month initially, with appetite to expand if unit economics line up
- Your target unit benchmark: roughly $800–$1,200 per 1M tokens (we discussed $/1M as an easy comparison point)

Proposed renewal/expansion structure (high level)
- Committed tiers (example blended rates):
  • 0–50M tokens/mo: $0.0009 / token ($900 / 1M)
  • 50–200M tokens/mo: $0.0007 / token ($700 / 1M)
  • 200M+ tokens/mo: $0.0005 / token ($500 / 1M)
- Effective blended rate will depend on the mix of routes/models (chat vs. embeddings vs. reranking). Adding lighter embedding-only routes will lower blended $/1M.
- Example: a 100M average month with a 60/40 split chat/embedding would net an effective blended ~ $650–700 / 1M.

Models & routes to add
- We recommended adding Redwood-Chat-Large for chat and RW-Embed for high-volume embeddings; we can provide model-specific rates if you prefer.

Attachments: I attached an updated proposal and a token forecast that maps your traffic patterns to tiered pricing (Acme_Renewal_Proposal_v3.pdf, acme_token-usage-forecast.xlsx).

Requested next steps
1) Can you confirm the procurement contact and expected decision timeline? (you mentioned legal + procurement review next week)
2) Confirm whether a 12-month committed term is preferred (we can price 6/12/24 mo options)
3) If the numbers look good, we can send a DocuSign-ready SOW with the tiered pricing and a sample blended example for your finance team.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call with procurement if helpful — I can bring our account finance lead.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole

Alex / Sandra / procurement team —

Thanks — below is the 12-month example you requested plus line-item unit economics to make sure finance has the right inputs.

12-month example (100M tokens/month average)\- Pricing tiers applied: 0–50M @ $900/1M, 50–200M @ $700/1M
- Monthly token split for 100M: 50M @ $900/1M + 50M @ $700/1M = (50*$900 + 50*$700) = $80,000 / month
- Annual committed spend (12 mo): $960,000
- Effective blended $/1M = $80,000 / 100 = $800 / 1M

Unit economics and assumptions\- Avg request length: 1,200 tokens for chat routes (we can tune)
- Embeddings average: 768 tokens per call (if used heavily it shifts blended down)
- We bill on token consumption (input + output) per the attached forecast

Discounts / credits options\- Standard committed-term discount (12 mo): 10% off list tiered rates above (would bring the effective blended to ~ $720 / 1M in the 100M example)
- One-time onboarding credit: we can offer up to $25k implementation credit for integrations + fine-tuning work at signature on a 12-mo commit

If you want a single-line invoice amount we can encode the 10% committed discount and a one-time credit to show net year-1 spend. I’ll produce that in a follow-up SOW and send via DocuSign when you confirm term length.

Next steps
- Marissa to produce SOW with 12-mo committed example + invoice line items (DocuSign link to follow) — target: today
- Procurement to confirm internal approver & expected PO timing
